purpose: Fixed query set Q01-Q12 from the 2026-11-14 baseline, replayed ONLY against synthetic fixtures. Each row is marked COVERED_FIXTURE or NOT_COVERED by the rule below; no production index/log/墨 source is read and no live hit count or live first pointer is claimed.
coverageRule: COVERED_FIXTURE is a narrow claim about ONE named surface leg at the baseline's own limit: Store, MCP and the importer helper (searchEchoWords / searchEchoSummaries) must match an independent oracle on pointer set, pointer order, count, exhausted and truncation. A row may be COVERED_FIXTURE only if its whole baseline SOURCE-LEG set is representable by the imported v9 ECHO derived index (i.e. it has no 墨 leg) AND no baseline option is ambiguous in v9 (a timezone-less since is ambiguous) AND at least one probe runs at the baseline's own limit on the surface the row's purpose names. A negative control (0 hits on a synthetic corpus) can never be COVERED: it says nothing about the baseline's global zero result over src=墨,索引. COVERED_FIXTURE never means live parity. Live hit counts, live first pointers, the 墨 leg, the words leg of src=索引, semantic recall and live memq opens are listed per row under notReproduced and are never counted as covered.
auxiliaryRule: A probe whose role is AUXILIARY_FIXTURE is a labelled synthetic test, never a coverage claim: it is run and reported, but it can never make its row COVERED_FIXTURE. Each carries establishes (what this synthetic run actually shows) and doesNotEstablish (what it must never be read as). Q01-Q03/Q07-Q09 auxiliaries exist because the row needs a 墨 leg or a global negative that v9 cannot express; Q04#2 exists only because limit=6 is beyond the baseline limit=3; Q06#1 uses an explicit UTC instant that is NOT the baseline timezone-less instant.
